fields.public_price: Whether at least one current usable monetary amount is published.
fields.prerequisite_costs: Other paid products/licenses required for this solution.
fields.estimated_enterprise_cost: Sensitivity estimate only when exact enterprise price is unavailable.
fields.confidence: Separate pricing-model confidence, monetary confidence, evidence grade, and estimate grade where relevant.
fields.cost_function: Normalized description of fixed and variable charging components; used later for scenario TCO.
fields.normalization: Optional normalized enterprise baseline for comparable seat/month, organization/year, or usage metrics.
fields.commercial_bundle_id: Optional shared commercial entitlement/bundle identifier used to prevent double counting.
fields.marginal_cost_rule: How to treat the record when another solution shares the same entitlement or when a paid prerequisite exists.
fields.evidence_scope: Whether evidence is an exact official price, partial official pricing, vendor secondary evidence, quote-only model, historical, etc.
